author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a bumpy broccoli crown of four florets on a U stalk to the left, and a tapered carrot on the diagonal with a round cap, pointed tip and two leaf stalks (up and right) to the right. Earlier candidates were rejected: on SQUARE the carrot came 6.7-7.7 from the stalk/crown (MIC) and read too thin, and a smoother three-lobe crown looked like a mushroom cap. The rejected drawing had a single-line stem and a plain triangle carrot.
omissions: The overlap between the carrot and the broccoli stalk in the reference is separated by 8 units; the stalk's hidden right edge and the small crank are replaced by a closed U stalk; the tick mark on the carrot's shoulder is dropped.
drawing_plan: HRECT_L. Crown cubic run x 4..25, y 8..22 on a base y=22; stalk U x 10..18 with r4 foot to y=40. Carrot axis (-3,4) from T=(37,25): r5 cap, mirror cubic sides to tip (28,37); leaves (40,21)-(40,8) and (40,21)-(44,18).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'carrot' (tapered diagonal body, straight leaf stalks) and 'cloud' (bumps with inward cusps).
